## oceanCells

[Implementation, line 31](../../../../../src/render/planet/water-geometry.ts#L31)

Which of the 64 z15 cells inside a z12 tile are ocean.
Bit `row * 8 + col` is set, row 0 at the north edge. Islands stay clear.
